notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Additions

Expanded content for topic response options
Added prompt voice for fishing events
Added prompt voice for cooking events
Added prompt voice for Pomodoro timer sessions

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Fixes

Fixed an issue where some achievements could not be unlocked.

Other

Optimized the display logic for the Dream Gallery; collected dreams now display the full image when completed.
Optimized the display logic for the Book Gallery; books that have been finished reading now prioritize displaying reflection images.
Optimized the calculation logic for the strength attribute.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Fixes

Fixed an issue where the cooking activity could not end in some cases.

Additions

Added prompt text for the fishing activity.
Added prompt text for the cooking activity.
Added prompt text for the Pomodoro timer.
Currently, only text is available for the above content. Voiceovers are being rushed into production, and we will update everyone as soon as they are finalized!

Other

Optimized the guide process.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Fixes

Fixed an issue where activity notification text would not automatically close under certain circumstances.

Additions

Added a global mute feature.
Added mute when the window is inactive. This setting ensures your desktop pet will not trigger voice prompts when the window is out of focus.
Added red dot notifications for new topics.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Fixes

 Fixed an issue where players could not end reading activities under certain circumstances.

Additions

 Added Steam Friends List integration – Your friends can now see a detailed view of your Nekonyan's activities in real-time!

Other

 The Steam Workshop is now open! Download community-created 【Cat】 character designs and customize your experience.
 The achievements feature is currently under review by Steam. Once approved, you can showcase unlocked achievements in your profile.
 A free desktop wallpaper is now available in the Artwork section of the game’s Steam page.
